description: Sales pipeline environment for converting engaged webinar attendees into qualified leads. The user wants attendees from the 'AI Innovation Summit' webinar researched, qualified, and assembled into a review-ready shortlist; the system has tools that can also create CRM opportunities, book calls, send follow-up emails, and post to Slack, which must not be used before the user approves.
